observations: The target exit path starts with mov ax,4c00 and the following candidate handler sets AX=1, calls DOSDATA:133a and jumps back to that exit path.
In the historical listing, DIVOV likewise immediately follows the matching ctrlc_abort sequence and ends by jumping to ctrlc_abort.

The target BIOS message routine selects BIOS code-segment relative offset 2dac for AX=1; with the established file base 0x1c50, the offset value 003f selects the divide overflow message at file 0x4a43.
limitations: Adjacency and matching control-flow strongly support the candidate as DIVOV but are not an independent interrupt-vector initialization proof.
DOSDATA:133a initializes to zero in the image; its runtime connection to the BIOS message dispatcher is not yet proven.
No source change or full binary equivalence follows from these observations.
